info.title: Kaladel.Kiota.NullabilityFix.TypeScript
info.description:
Post-processes Kiota-generated TypeScript models so that properties marked as
            "required" (and non-nullable) in the source OpenAPI document are emitted as
            required/non-nullable TypeScript properties, instead of Kiota's default of making
            every property optional and nullable.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Tightens Kiota-generated TypeScript model types to match 'required'/nullable information from the source OpenAPI document.

options.name: --openapi
options.description: Path to the OpenAPI document that was used to generate the Kiota TypeScript client.

options.name: --kiota-output
options.description: Path to the directory Kiota generated the TypeScript client into (the directory containing 'models/index.ts').
